resolved_findings.evidence: Windows retains the scoped Job handle, requests TerminateJobObject when active processes remain, and queries BasicAccounting.ActiveProcesses until zero before closing the handle. Failure to confirm completion within the bounded grace period raises an error, preventing PASS. Suspended creation and job assignment before resume preserve ownership after direct-parent exit. Both inherited-stdout and quiet-stdout descendant regressions executed and passed independently on Windows; the quiet-child case confirms its listening socket is released before the invocation returns.

prevalidate_step_paths resolves every setup/scenario/cleanup cwd, recognized script and executable before execute_plan creates output or starts setup. Bare commands are resolved with shutil.which; explicit executable paths must exist within the permitted repository scope, with the interpreter placeholder handled explicitly. It retains the resolved absolute argv, cwd and sanitized environment in prepared_steps, and run_step uses that prepared tuple without repeating lookup. The missing cleanup executable regression now returns 2 with neither trace nor evidence directory. A real nonzero cleanup exit and a separately injected interrupted-cleanup/evidence-write error both preserve later cleanup and a final FAIL report.

Recognized Python forms require a .py script and recognized PowerShell forms require exact -File plus a .ps1 script, with explicitly supported preceding options. The regression rejects the previously accepted -c, -e, implicit PowerShell and sh.exe -c forms. Accepted interpreter parsing was inspected; no PowerShell lab scenario was executed.
